# MRMProLeads

MRMProLeads provides research-led B2B account intelligence and ABM research for B2B SaaS teams and outbound agencies.

## Core services
- ICP and target-account research
- Buying committee and decision-maker mapping
- Buying-signal and opportunity research
- Public business contact research and enrichment
- Sales intelligence and structured account handoffs
- White-label research for outbound agencies

## Pricing
- $99 Paid Research Test — 3 accounts
- $199 Account Intelligence Sprint — 10 accounts
- $299 Buying Committee Intelligence — 10 accounts
- $499 Strategic Account Intelligence — 10 accounts
- $399/month Monthly Account Intelligence — 10 fresh accounts/month

## Research standard
Research uses publicly available business information and publicly accessible professional data. Private or non-public personal information is outside the operating standard.
